purpose: Replace only the memory representation and execution of endpoint-safe rank-IBD residualization for fresh phylogatR Phase 3 after the original exact implementation was killed during response-blind design construction on the frozen Phase-2 geometry.

trigger.observed_failure: The original prepare_crossfit_ibd_design materializes per-target training-index and centered-rank arrays and was killed by the execution environment before one fresh synthetic reference world produced an output.
trigger.largest_observed_geometry: Entomobrya nivalis: 295 frozen localities and 8711 frozen graph edges

equivalence_contract.target_training_set: exactly the edges sharing neither endpoint with the target edge
equivalence_contract.rank_semantics: 1-based average ranks with the existing deterministic tie rule
equivalence_contract.regression_semantics: same ordinary least-squares slope/intercept and held-out expected rank fraction as the existing reference implementation
equivalence_contract.residual_turnover: same existing rank01 transformation of residuals
required_tests: compact IBD equals the existing reference implementation with and without ties
compact fresh batch equals the existing generic batch for statistic, training strength, n_eval_species, and held-out species scores

execution_change_only.compact_storage: global edge ranks plus per-locality incident-edge rank corrections instead of one training-index/rank array per target edge
execution_change_only.parallelism: target edges may execute in parallel; within each target edge the edge accumulation order remains deterministic
